w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💀 The Spool killed Aurora in 6 rounds. The village mourns.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Chorus Line mauled Ethan (-28 health) over 15 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Terms of Service is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Herald, The Big Beast, The Callback, The Big Beast) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×2 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +50% HP, +24% damage, +1 in the pack.)
firstContext: 📼 RERUN ×2 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +50% HP, +24% damage, +1 in the pack.)

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
firstContext: 🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile south caught a Cottontail Rabbit! — set it, waited, and the old way worked. About 800 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
The garden: your untended Blackberry drowned in weeds and died. (Six untended days. The garden keeps honest books.)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
— DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Gray Squirrel (cleaned); 16 White Oak Acorns (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Big Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1040 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/13/7), with 7 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Diana Osei ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Diana Osei and Greta Hansen ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
